// ==== HAND-WRITTEN BELOW HERE -- genbodies.py KEEPS THIS ====

// THE MENU ITSELF IS HAND-WRITTEN. genbodies.py owns only the body list above, because that
// has to track which bodies are actually installed -- offering one that is not there spawns
// nothing and says so in a console the owner cannot read from inside a headset.
//
// It used to template this whole menu too, and the template had fallen a long way behind
// what is below: no height section, no helmet section, no colour option, none of the
// explanatory lines. Running the generator would have replaced the real menu with the older,
// poorer one and said nothing, because generating succeeds.
